anomalies.observed: On SkylabModule.kicad_sch the drain of the display-power P-MOSFET (Q1, pin 3) carries the global label NET0015 - the same label that is used for an Ethernet LAN pair (the LAN port pins on U1 in the same sheet and the RJ-45 data pads on EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch). The EPD panel supply rail that this switch is supposed to feed appears in EPD_Driver.kicad_sch as a different global net, NET0001, which feeds L3/C8/C12 and the panel VDD/VDDIO pins (U10.15/U10.16) and therefore has no source anywhere in the design.
anomalies.expected: Q1's drain must be on the same net as the EPD display supply rail (the 'Display_Power_Switch' node that feeds J1.15/J1.16 and the EPD boost input C1/C2/L1), not merged with an Ethernet LAN line.

evidence.quote: SkylabModule.kicad_sch (page 2/4): global label 'NET0015' on Q1 pin 3, and the same label 'NET0015' on one of U1's LAN-port pins; EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch (page 4/4) uses 'NET0015' on J8's data pads
EPD_Driver.kicad_sch (page 3/4): global label 'NET0001' on the display supply rail feeding L3, C8, C12 and U10.15/U10.16
Q2.3 (drain) ties to the `Display_Power_Switch` net, which feeds `J1.15`/`J1.16` — the EPD panel's `VDDIO`/`VDD` pins per the PDI pin table — plus the EPD boost converter's `L1`, `C1`, `C2`.

anomalies.impact: The EPD panel's VDD/VDDIO rail is never driven, so the display cannot power up, and the 3.3 V display rail is instead tied to an Ethernet LAN line (via Q1 when the power switch is on), corrupting/loading that LAN pair and possibly stressing the SKW92A LAN pin.

anomalies.observed: EPD_Driver.kicad_sch contains only two SS2040FL Schottky rectifiers (marked U6 and U7); no third SS2040FL diode symbol exists on that sheet (the only other SS2040FL in the project is U9, the battery-feed diode on EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch).
anomalies.expected: The EPD boost/charge-pump stage must contain three SS2040FL rectifiers (the PDI reference circuit and the Meshinger BOM both specify 3x SS2040FL for this exact circuit), i.e. the boost rectifier plus the two charge-pump/multiplier rectifiers.

evidence.quote: | Diode: "SS2040FL SOD-123FL", qty 3 | U1, U2, U3 = `SS2040FL` ×3 | Exact part, exact quantity |
EPD_Driver.kicad_sch (page 3/4): only the diode symbols labelled 'U7 SS2040FL' and 'U6 SS2040FL' are drawn

anomalies.impact: One rectifier of the charge-pump/multiplier is missing, so one of the panel's generated rails (VEE/VGL style pump rail) is not produced, leaving the EPD panel unable to refresh (or able to produce only part of its required high-voltage rails).
